observations.fact: All mutation commands use one PostgreSQL transaction-scoped advisory lock; writer conflict includes same task, current/pending destination worktree and equal/ancestor/descendant literal paths; receipt/audit are committed atomically.

Version and current actor are checked; handoff_pending prevents original writer actions; released claims cannot mutate. Staleness is a needsVerification observation, not release or permission to steal. Failed observer is unknown.

A registered task still receives active claims if registry branch/worktree differs, with matchesSource=false. Unregistered active claims remain separately visible. The registry is the sole source of progress paths; claim paths are not dynamically trusted as new status sources.

UI only combines assignment observations matching the summary registry fingerprint; it exposes exact actor, branch/worktree, scope, version, state, stale-but-held and mismatch. Source change aborts pending old detail/document reads while retaining prior content explicitly as previous observation.
Existing test source covers stale handoff owner, mismatched source, unregistered claim, released exclusion and unknown read failure. This review did not execute it.
